svg.title: From files to running processes
svg.desc: Worked example on the Pecos QA sandbox. Top: the configuration files on disk. Middle: the launch file reads them once. Bottom: the ROS nodes that then run, grouped by the reason they exist.

g.text: The QA sandbox's chargers C14 and C16 are AGV chargers (AgvCharge), which need no node of their own; only EV chargers (EvCharge) get a VECS node.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Configuration files describe the site and the starting state; they do nothing by themselves. The launch file reads them and starts the running programs (ROS nodes). Which nodes exist follows from

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the files: one simulated AGV per AGV in the scenario, one set of bay nodes per bay in the layout, and a fixed set that every simulation has.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
